content: Aŋun'naaŋ, ngyɛb akà bɛ!
Abun, bɛ aŋun'naaŋ, làlel anà in'kwɛŋ, ntɔn mpay iyàyà udu a bɛ!
Un'naaŋ abɛ wàŋàpɔɔn, ipfɛy abɛ in'swab myàkyàdyàdyà.
Wɔl abɛ anà ngim abɛ yàŋàbwà an'tär, an'tär ama màsàlatɛɛl imbäl ibe, ma màsàdyà in'twaŋ abɛ asànaa mbaa. Bɛ làkyàköŋà in'naaŋ u ntsüü a taaŋ!
Le, bɛ làkyàtɔn mufur baar bàfàsal uboo a an'ywaŋ abɛ. Làfur aba alà làmusà in'kwɛŋ, anà Nzam, Mwol aŋità, akyàwem in'tär a abweel abà.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ u mɛɛn kan'kal aŋàyɔl a indiir a ntwɛn anà un'sak. Ndür abɛ làkyàbuul may may asànaa ntsür adilà ilä mukyɛl un'kwaal.
Bɛ làpɛ ntaaŋàmbar anà làdwä mbuur a balàbal. Nde in'peen kàlasi anki.
Nkääŋ a mpem
Abun, atɔŋ, làkäl anà nkääŋ a mpem tii u ngyeel a Mwol. Làler un'lem a an'ywaŋ: nde afàdil imbɛŋ a mfun ifàtoo u mɛɛn ukɔɔn ayɔn tii mpal usàwal nde mbɛŋ atàtwɛb anà yàngöngö.
Bɛ sye, làkäl anà nkääŋ a mpem. Làkäl anà mpem aŋàtsim ntɔn ngyeel a Mwol yà tsütsü.
Atɔŋ, twon lan'kal anà buul u mpem bɛ a bɛ, ntɔn mutiin mukal kusà a làbay a nsaŋ. Le, ntɛɛn wà u mun a mbwo!
Atɔŋ, unsà ndaa iler mpay anà nkääŋ a mpem, mbaan alab yà yà aŋangɔɔm abà bàtɛn kà ikɔb a Mwol.
Làler: bi ifàkan aŋàmun'küünà. Bɛ làkyàwem làsaŋ a nkääŋ a mpem a Yɔb anà bɛ làkyàyöb ndaa kun'kyer Mwol, ntɔn Mwol wàŋàyɔl a mpem a ukwen anà ngyɛb.

Wɛɛ unsà ya yanswà, atɔŋ amɛ, twon lan'dyà kyän itàkal u du, itàkal u mɛɛn, itàkal kà aben. Wɛy naa: « Inye » abɛ làkäl inye anà « Aay » abɛ làkäl aay, ntɔn bɛ làkɔɔn akwɛlà u mbar a Nzam.
Ngyamàkà ntɔn abɛy
Nkye umwɛy uboo a bɛ wà unsà mpay? Wɛy nde uyamà. Nkye nde wà unsà un'sak? Wɛy nde utɔ̈l an'diim.
Nkye wà anà mbuur uboo a bɛ awe anà ukyal? Wɛy nde ubel andweer a Ikööŋ, ntɔn ba bun'si u ngyamàkà, waa ungö bun'tsuul may udu a un'tswe ande kà ikↄb a Mwol.
Ngyamàkà a làkwikilà isàkɔɔr un'bɛy, Mwol akyer asumbaar. Isàkal naa nde we anà man'be, bàkyerà asun'dwääl ma.
Làkyey man'be abɛ bɛ a bɛ anà làyamà bɛ a bɛ, ntɔn bɛ làkɔɔrà. Ngyamàkà a mbuur a balàbal ifàsal ngwal mbɔɔn.
Ɛli kàkäl mbuur asànaa bi, nde kàyamà unsà muküünà naa mbul ukɔ̈ɔ̈n anɔ, wa sye kànɔ̈ anki u mɛɛn isii a mbul tär a ngɔn syaam.
Ungö, kàfàyamà nde, mbul kàkyer anɔ, mɛɛn màtwey imbɛŋ ama.
Atɔŋ amɛ, isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a bɛ wàŋàbwà ndwaŋ, ukwɛl anà ndandaa, wɛɛ mbuur asin kàmun'fuur,
làyöb naa ufuur mbuur a man'be u mbwo kàwɛy nde, yà mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande kà ukwà, anà mubiiŋ un'kàbɔ a man'be.
